messages:
asha: Heads up — noticed canary abort endpoint (/rollouts/:id/abort) returning 200 for service account 'ops-bot' even when policy should deny it.
benji: repro steps? which env?
asha: staging-usw2. QA triggered an abort, curl returned:
```
{"status":"ok","message":"aborted"}
```
but the caller only had deploy_viewer role.
infra-bot: [deploy-event] rollout 0x7f9 aborted by ops-bot (service-account) :robot_face:
claire: that sounds like a missing enforcement path in the gatekeeper middleware — maybe an upstream auth error falling through?
benji: can you paste the auth+acl log snippet? also any KMS calls around the same time?
asha: audit shows upstream acl check returned 403 for the principal. our code then hit the "auth fallback" branch that was introduced in v2.3.1 and we accidentally allow on error. snippet:
```
WARN auth: acl check failed: 403 unauthorized
INFO rollout: abort request received
INFO rollout: fallback_to_allow=true
```
claire: ugh. fallback_to_allow was meant for read-only endpoints where availability trumped auth during a migration. never for mutation paths like abort. I'll push a quick revert to make fallback_to_deny the default for anything under /rollouts/*/mutate.
benji: agree. immediate plan: 1) disable fallback for mutate endpoints, 2) add explicit role check that only 'rollout_admin' or 'ops_lead' can abort, 3) add automated test exercising the 403 path. I can run a hotfix to staging.
infra-bot: CI build 4021 passed, deploying hotfix to staging now :rocket:
asha: after hotfix I still want audit entries correlated with KMS access — if the service-account used a KMS key to sign the request token we should rotate keys if any unauthorized abort happened. sec-eng-lead, any guidance?
sec-eng-lead: create a short incident draft. rotate keys for ops-bot credentials used in the window, but don't disrupt ongoing canaries until we confirm no active breaches. require: timeline, affected rollouts, decision on rotation. also add an alert: any abort events where actor not in [rollout_admin, ops_lead] -> Pager.
claire: added unit + e2e tests; PR #4870 opened with revert + tests. also added explicit audit_event tags: "perm_denied" and "auth_fallback_blocked" so we can query fast.
benji: I'll run the staging test matrix (access denied -> 403 -> should NOT abort). if green I'll promote with canary to prod and monitor for 30m.
asha: noted. I'll open the postmortem and include timeline + KMS audit call ids. Draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security-incidents/pulls/12 :eyes:
infra-bot: staging -> prod canary roll started (canary=10%).
sec-eng-lead: good. after prod rollout, follow up with a short blameless postmortem. add runbook entry so fallback behavior is explicitly allowed-only-for-read and documented.
benji: thanks — leaving a todo to add lint rule to fail builds that set fallback_to_allow on write endpoints.
asha: :thumbsup: closing the loop once prod canary is healthy.
